title:
Simplified version of {@link UiSdlEpic}.

Simple epics are synchronous, operate on a single action (instead of on an observable of actions)
and return a collection of actions (instead of an observable of actions)

It is recommended to use UiSdlSimpleEpic when you are only interested in one action at a time
and you don't need any RxJs operators (like delay, skipUntil, throttle, etc).
name: UiSdlSimpleEpic
